info.title: AIGP-Lite API
info.description: API reference for AIGP-Lite. REST routes are executable as documented. tRPC entries describe the canonical procedures exposed via /api/trpc/{procedure} and are intended as integration reference.

cookieAuth.name: authjs.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth session cookie used by browser-authenticated API routes.

bearerAuth.description: Runtime API key, for example Authorization: Bearer aigp_...

serviceNowWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
serviceNowWebhookSecret.description: Shared secret configured for the ServiceNow inbound integration.
